entities.name: Query Ham1p-like protein
observations: The supplied protein is 201 aa long and has a predicted molecular mass of 22.58 kDa.
Pfam scanning identifies a Ham1p_like domain (PF01725.22) spanning residues 5–191.
Homologs support assignment as a dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase, but exact substrate preference remains inferred rather than experimentally established for this sequence.

entities.name: dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase
observations: Reviewed homologs Q9KUQ9, Q87LJ1, and Q7N7H2 are annotated as EC 3.6.1.66 dITP/XTP pyrophosphatases.
The enzyme hydrolyzes noncanonical purine nucleoside triphosphates, especially XTP, dITP, and ITP, to their monophosphate derivatives and diphosphate.
Reviewed homologs bind one Mg(2+) ion per subunit and form homodimers.
The proposed biological role is nucleotide-pool sanitization to limit incorporation of abnormal purines into nucleic acids.
